integrity: Original analytic proof with separately executable finite diagnostic code; exact rational witness included. No independent mathematical validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two-site criterion is ambient Euclidean with constant SPD metrics. Three-site classification assumes collinear sites and scalar site matrices with lambda>1 and 0<mu<1. No result for all anisotropic three-site configurations. Boundary tangency does not automatically imply smooth contact-function regularity. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp minimal-site visibility and three-site phase thresholds in quadratic Voronoi geometry
